purpose.domain_detail: Italian small-business price-list management (listini clienti = customer price lists); manages articles, customers, customer types, and per-customer price rows with up to three price levels
purpose.summary: glistini.cbl is a generated ACUCOBOL-GT GUI program that manages customer price lists (listini clienti) for an Italian business application. It provides a form-based interface with a grid showing articles and their three price levels, linked to customer and article master files. The program supports create, read, update, delete, and print/export operations on price-list records.
